stem: An employee contacts his supervisor to request time off guaranteed to him under the Family and Medical Leave Act. Under which circumstance do the provisions of this law apply?

options.label: F
options.text: The employee qualifies for time off to complete a college degree.

options.label: G
options.text: The employee qualifies for time off to care for a newborn child.

options.label: H
options.text: The employee qualifies for an extended vacation due to airline delays.

options.label: J
options.text: The employee qualifies for assignment to a different work location.
